featured_reviews.review_text:
I had one of the worst experiences with Parthenon Architects, especially with Architect Zaki. Their behavior and professionalism are extremely disappointing.
From the beginning, Zaki’s attitude was rude, arrogant, and completely unprofessional. Instead of guiding us, he behaved as if he was doing us a favour. Basic communication, updates, and respect for clients were totally missing.

They make tall promises but deliver nothing on time. Every discussion ended in confusion because Zaki never listened properly and always argued unnecessarily. Even small changes became a huge issue. Their approach shows zero responsibility and no customer value.

Overall, I would never recommend Parthenon Architects to anyone. There are plenty of better and more professional firms out there who actually respect clients and deliver quality work.
Please save your time, money, and peace of mind — avoid this firm.

Mr Zaki and his team were amazing to work with! I was looking forward to renovate my house into a space unlike the design cliches but had very little insights. They had a great vision and many ideas which were brilliantly executed. Mr Zaki understood our taste and was very thoughtful about the kind of arrangement that we wanted in every room. The best part about their work was that they made every room look spacious through their design intelligence and also suggested various creative treatment that could be given to the corners. They solved our dilemma of the kind of theme that we wanted, by incorporating a combination of elements making my house look chic and stylish yet infused with traditional touch.
They made sure that the patterns are contemporary and created an ambience makes one stay a little longer.
The team is an innovation enthusiast. They have a great eye for colour coordination, and helped us out with their artistic vision. He gave a lovely character to every room. Keeping in mind our requirements, they have managed our project with utmost proficiency, wholehearted dedication and timely coordination.

featured_reviews.name: Vikram Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Beware! Its a Fraud Company!
We had the misfortune of assigning them the contract for our corporate office renovation.
This is how they operate :
Firstly, they would  make tall promises and back it up with fake achievements and tons of lies.
They would use utmost low quality materials, poor project handling and overall a very shabby work. We had to get the entire thing re-done from some other company.
Now the best part, once their job is done, they wouldn't be even available to answer you, for basically the little after sales service that you expect. Infact, after repeated follow-ups they turned hostile and abusive, including the top management.
An utterly unprofessional, inexperienced and fraudulent firm with a very bad market reputation. Met many others like me later on who had the same experience like us. Hope had met them earlier, would have saved us the stress! We have heard they don't pay up their suppliers as well and deny them of their payment in the end.
Stay away from this firm if you love your hard earned money and peace of mind whether you are a client or a supplier. I felt the responsibility to share this to save others from the turmoil we went through.

P.S. - They usually label whoever writes a negative review about them as their 'ex suspended employee'. Which is ofcourse not true! Cheap tactics. Infact, am sure the positive reviews are their own.
